title: SAML assertion tamperproofing & KMS integration validation scenarios
creator: Aisha K. Patel
description: This ticket defines the PRD addendum and acceptance scenarios for validating tamper-resistance of inbound SAML assertions and the end-to-end integration with customer-managed KMS/HSM during Private deployments. Goal: provide a reproducible test checklist, operator runbooks, and signed-off evidence artifacts that satisfy both engineering and compliance teams for customer onboarding.
background: Customers running Redwood Private require auditable proof that SAML assertions used for federated authentication are protected from tampering and that signing keys integrated with their KMS/HSM are used correctly during assertion generation and verification. Previous onboarding runs revealed inconsistent evidence artifacts and gaps in operator steps when rotating keys or migrating tenant metadata.
acceptance_criteria: Test harness reproduces assertion signing and verification flow with a customer KMS endpoint (simulated HSM) and logs assertion provenance for three key rotation modes: manual rotation, automatic rotation with dual-signing window, and emergency rollback.
End-to-end trace shows assertion signature verified by Redwood runtime and the customer SP consumes ExpectedAttributes in 95% of sampled requests during load tests (latency < 250ms extra).

Audit log entries are generated for: assertion issuance, signature verification result, KMS key id used, key version/fingerprint, and operator-triggered key rotations. Each entry conforms to the audit schema in Confluence doc 'Audit Schema v2' and is stored with tenant_id context.

Tamper-injection test (bit flip, replayed envelope, modified AttributeStatement) causes verification failures that are observable in trace and trigger escalation rule 'saml-signature-failure' in console alerts.
Operator runbook validated in a dry-run with a solutions engineer and results captured in a step-by-step artifact (Google Doc) with timestamped evidence and a linked GitHub PR for any infra changes.
Security sign-off by Compliance and Security Eng: acceptance artifacts uploaded to the evidence bucket and referenced in the ticket.
checklist: Create PRD addendum summarizing validation scope and test matrix
Implement test harness to sign, modify, and verify SAML assertions against KMS simulated HSM
Add structured audit events for KMS key usage to runtime (schema alignment)
Define and run tamper-injection scenarios against staging private deployment
Collect and upload evidence (logs, traces, screenshots) to evidence drive
Schedule review session with Security/Compliance and record sign-off in ticket
test_plan: Unit tests for assertion serializer/deserializer and signature verification (coverage > 90%)
Integration: sign via KMS client, deliver to SP endpoint in staging, verify assertion and record audit event
Chaos: apply bit-flip to assertion payload and ensure verification fails and alert fires
Performance: run 10k SAML assertions through runtime with KMS mock and measure p50/p95/p99 verification latencies
risks: Staging KMS emulator behavior may differ from customer HSMs; mitigate by capturing key fingerprints and vendor behavior notes
Additional latency when performing remote KMS signing could impact login UX; require SLA adjustments or local caching strategy
Audit volume may increase storage costs—need quota estimate for long-running onboards
notes: For KMS simulation use 'kms-emulator-v2' image pinned in infra PR to avoid drift
We will reuse existing audit schema fields: event_type, tenant_id, key_id, key_version, verification_result
Coordinate with Solutions Eng: book customer slot for live verification on 2026-03-18
Consider adding a compact signature fingerprint to assertion IDs for faster offline correlation
